info.cls_ename: Master's Program, Department of Cooperative Economics

description.describe_ch: 研討行銷管理之程序，主要包括：分析行銷環境、策略性行銷決策、戰術性行銷決策、行銷執行與控制等。其中策略性行銷及戰術性行銷，乃藉以瞭解所謂STP之市場區隔、選擇目標市場及定位，以及所謂4P's之產品、定價、通路及推廣等
description.describe_eh: This course include the integration of key marketing perspectives , emphasizing new thinking and approaches to marketing practice. This requires the ability to assess complex and changing marketing situation, to determine the best marketing strategies for these situations and to execute the strategies effectively. The course will be help students develop the understanding and skill to become successful marketers

gradeRules.evalb_memo_en: course participation includes group discussion, individual oral presentation of papers(20%), and class participation

gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new:
1.	Individual participation (40%) : the attendance and participation in in-class discussion
2.	Mid-term report (30%): each student need to make an oral presentation of a paper assigned in English. Slides that include the summary, critique, and extended case discussion should be handed in by the date of presentation.
3.	Term project (30%): In addition to English oral presentation, students also need to hand in a well structured report written in English.
gradeRuleDescribe.tpa_score_new_en: 1. Individual participation (40%) : the attendance and participation in in-class discussion. Besides, each student need to make an oral presentation of a paper assigned in English. Slides that include the summary, critique, and extended case discussion should be handed in by the date of presentation. 2. Class attendance (10%): students need to check their attendance in class. 3. Homework and assignments (20%) 4. Term project (30%): In addition to English oral presentation, students also need to hand in a well structured report written in English.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol: Students are encouraged to use English as much as possible during discussions in the classroom (mixing in some Chinese is acceptable). As class participation accounts for a significant portion of the grade, it is recommended that students contribute to discussions whenever possible. For case studies, it is essential to complete the readings beforehand to facilitate subsequent classroom discussions.

gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem: The course requires group discussions, necessitating active participation from each student.

gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: Students' final projects must not plagiarize or use ChatGPT or any other AI tools for generation. Content of midterm and final reports will be checked for plagiarism, with a maximum allowable similarity percentage of 15%. The reports must clearly indicate the sources of information and reference. Plagiarism is a serious breach of academic trust. In schoolwork, our words and thoughts are the value of our work; so submitting someone else's work as our own is a form of theft. When you use someone else's words and ideas, whether by a famous author or a classmate, without acknowledging the source of those articles, words and ideas, you are plagiarizing. Original work is my bottom line, plagiarized work will receive a "0" or "fail" score.
